sections.description: Explores the patient’s demographic and clinical features, vital signs, family history, and baseline laboratory findings that prompted further investigation for a non‑typical diabetic phenotype.

sections.description: Defines the reasoning that led clinicians to consider monogenic diabetes (MODY) over classic type 1 or type 2 diabetes and outlines the laboratory tests used to refine the differential.
